principle: Preserve native source identity and bytes first; derive only the smallest justified machine-readable semantic state; keep loss, inference and representation boundaries explicit.

R0_EXACT.meaning: Exact retained or referenced native source bytes plus provider identity/hash.

R1_SEMANTIC_REVERSIBLE.meaning: Typed structural extraction with exact source locators/raw values sufficient to reconstruct the declared extracted scope.

R2_RECONSTRUCTED.meaning: Semantic objects/relations reconstructed from source structure or meaning; not byte-reversible.

R3_GENERATIVE.meaning: Generated explanation, summary, visualization, layout, synthetic view or other representation.

pipeline: R0 preserve/reference exact source + SHA/provider ID
R1 extract exact bounded structure with stable source locators where supported
R2 map admitted objects, relations, claims, evidence, parameters and gates
R3 generate requested human/machine representation from resolved state
Resolve semantic delta only through owning authority/evidence gates
invariants: no bulk file-format conversion automatically transfers semantic authority
native source/provider authority is preserved unless an explicit authority transition is receipted
unknown or unsupported structure remains Frontier rather than being guessed
R3 views never close R0/R1/R2 evidence gaps
every derived object carries source locator(s), conversion class and provenance
conversion output is capability-specific; models/tools receive only the bounded projection they can faithfully consume
round-trip claims apply only to the declared R1 scope, not to the whole source file
